extension.description: View Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Google Antigravity usage and quotas in one panel. Manual refresh only; reads local data, and only contacts a provider when you explicitly opt in.
view.name: Usage
config.claude.cliPath: Path to the Claude CLI. With the default `claude`, Quota Deck searches `PATH` first (including `claude.cmd` on Windows), then the binary bundled with the VSCode extension.
config.claude.autoProbeOnStale: When the Claude usage cache is missing or older than 15 minutes and you press refresh, automatically run a background Haiku probe for live official quota. **This sends a real API request through the claude CLI and counts toward your Claude usage**, so it is off by default.
config.codex.cliPath: Path to the Codex CLI. With the default `codex`, Quota Deck searches `PATH` first (including `codex.cmd` on Windows), then the binary bundled with the VSCode extension.
config.codex.allowDirectApi: Allow reading `auth.json` to query rate limits directly. **This path reads a local credential file and makes network requests**, so it is off by default. You normally do not need it, because Codex already writes official quota numbers to its local session logs.
config.commandTimeoutMs: Timeout (ms) for each CLI run and local network request.
config.showStatusBarItem: Show a usage summary in the status bar.
config.statusBar.provider: Which provider the status bar shows.
config.debug: Write verbose logs to the `Quota Deck` output channel.
config.statusBar.provider.lowest: Show the provider with the least quota left
